journey.title: My Journey
journey.text1: I'm a full-stack developer and digital illustrator based in Spain. My journey into tech began with a fascination for how things work, and evolved into a passion for building them.
journey.text2: What sets me apart is my unique combination of technical skills and artistic vision. As an illustrator, I've developed a deep understanding of visual design, user experience, and creative storytelling; skills that directly translate into creating beautiful, intuitive web applications.
journey.text3: When I'm not coding or drawing, you'll find me exploring new design trends, playing video games, capturing moments through photography, or singing along to my favorite songs. I'm a huge fan of animated series and films, and I believe music is the soundtrack to creativity. I believe the future of web development lies in the intersection of functionality and aesthetics, and I strive to embody that balance in everything I create.

illustration.subtitle: My Creative Side
illustration.text1: Beyond coding, I am a freelance digital illustrator. I create custom artwork for clients ranging from keychain designs to character designs and brand or personal illustrations.
illustration.text2: This dual career path enriches both my technical and creative work. My illustration experience helps me:
